instruments.name: go_gc_duration_seconds
instruments.semantics: garbage collection pause duration summary from the Go collector

instruments.name: go_goroutines
instruments.semantics: current goroutine count

instruments.name: go_memstats_heap_alloc_bytes
instruments.semantics: currently allocated heap bytes

instruments.name: go_memstats_heap_inuse_bytes
instruments.semantics: heap spans in use in bytes

instruments.name: go_memstats_sys_bytes
instruments.semantics: bytes obtained from the operating system

instruments.name: process_cpu_seconds_total
instruments.semantics: cumulative process CPU seconds

instruments.name: process_max_fds
instruments.semantics: maximum file descriptors when supported

instruments.name: process_open_fds
instruments.semantics: current open file descriptors when supported

instruments.name: process_resident_memory_bytes
instruments.semantics: resident process memory bytes

instruments.name: process_start_time_seconds
instruments.semantics: process start Unix timestamp in seconds

instruments.name: process_virtual_memory_bytes
instruments.semantics: virtual process memory bytes

instruments.name: tnl_admission_limit
instruments.semantics: Resolved admission limit by fixed resource; per-URL and per-hostname resources are per key.

instruments.name: tnl_admission_rejections_total
instruments.semantics: Admission rejected because a bounded resource was full.

instruments.name: tnl_api_request_duration_seconds
instruments.semantics: tnl API handler duration including long polls; count is the request total.

instruments.name: tnl_api_requests_in_flight
instruments.semantics: tnl API requests currently executing by component.

instruments.name: tnl_authorization_decisions_total
instruments.semantics: Semantic authorization results, independent of HTTP status.

instruments.name: tnl_client_lifecycle_events_total
instruments.semantics: Native app registration and publication-ready transitions, emitted once by the lifecycle owner; reads do not emit transitions.

instruments.name: tnl_client_operation_duration_seconds
instruments.semantics: Finite native CLI and private IPC operations; excludes process lifetime and application work.

instruments.name: tnl_control_certificate_claims_total
instruments.semantics: Certificate worker claims by certificate kind and outcome.

instruments.name: tnl_control_certificate_milestone_age_seconds
instruments.semantics: Time from issuance creation to certificate availability or DNS cleanup; availability does not imply installation.

instruments.name: tnl_control_certificate_orders_total
instruments.semantics: New service certificate orders committed by this control process, excluding idempotent retries and certificate reuse; not a CA issuance quota.

instruments.name: tnl_control_certificate_transitions_total
instruments.semantics: Committed certificate work transitions by kind and resulting state.

instruments.name: tnl_control_certificate_work_duration_seconds
instruments.semantics: Certificate worker advance and save duration; count is the number of claimed iterations.

instruments.name: tnl_control_cleanup_items_total
instruments.semantics: Committed items removed by cleanup kind.

instruments.name: tnl_control_cleanup_last_success_timestamp_seconds
instruments.semantics: Unix time of last successful cleanup by kind; zero before success.

instruments.name: tnl_control_cleanup_runs_total
instruments.semantics: Cleanup calls by fixed kind and outcome.

instruments.name: tnl_control_connection_assignments_replaced_total
instruments.semantics: Committed replacement of connection assignments by fixed reason.

instruments.name: tnl_control_dns_transitions_total
instruments.semantics: Committed DNS work transitions by kind and resulting state.

instruments.name: tnl_control_dns_work_duration_seconds
instruments.semantics: DNS worker phase duration; count is the number of attempts.

instruments.name: tnl_control_guest_trials_last_24h
instruments.semantics: Service-wide trial counts from committed state over the last 24 hours; use max rather than sum across control replicas.

instruments.name: tnl_control_operation_duration_seconds
instruments.semantics: Completed control state operation duration by fixed operation and outcome.

instruments.name: tnl_control_placement_decisions_total
instruments.semantics: Publish run placement decisions by action and bounded result.

instruments.name: tnl_control_public_url_recovery_duration_seconds
instruments.semantics: Duration of newly committed public URL recovery observations on this control process.

instruments.name: tnl_control_public_url_usage_items_total
instruments.semantics: Usage runs, buckets or deliveries committed by result.

instruments.name: tnl_control_public_url_usage_last_success_timestamp_seconds
instruments.semantics: Unix time of the last successful finalization call or committed delivery; zero before success.

instruments.name: tnl_control_public_url_usage_receiver_duration_seconds
instruments.semantics: Usage receiver request duration by bounded outcome.

instruments.name: tnl_control_public_url_usage_work_total
instruments.semantics: Usage worker operations by fixed phase and outcome.

instruments.name: tnl_control_public_urls_created_total
instruments.semantics: New public URLs committed by client-declared purpose; excludes idempotent retries.

instruments.name: tnl_control_publish_run_readiness_age_seconds
instruments.semantics: Age of the publish run at a readiness decision; excludes other errors.

instruments.name: tnl_control_publish_run_readiness_duration_seconds
instruments.semantics: Time spent checking and publishing publish run readiness; count is the number of attempts.

instruments.name: tnl_control_publish_runs_ready_total
instruments.semantics: Publish runs first marked ready by their saved public URL purpose.

instruments.name: tnl_control_publisher_runtime_duration_seconds
instruments.semantics: Signed publisher runtime inspect/start/renew/stop decisions; identity dimensions attach only after proof verification.

instruments.name: tnl_control_routing_history_cleanup_rows_total
instruments.semantics: Committed routing-history cleanup rows by action.

instruments.name: tnl_control_routing_history_cleanup_skipped_total
instruments.semantics: Cleanup batches skipped because another control holds the cleanup guard.

instruments.name: tnl_control_routing_history_retained_after_revision
instruments.semantics: Highest committed routing-history retention floor observed by this process.

instruments.name: tnl_control_tcp_port_pool_last_success_timestamp_seconds
instruments.semantics: Last complete successful inventory refresh; zero before success. Use maximum across control replicas.

instruments.name: tnl_control_tcp_port_pool_ports
instruments.semantics: Fresh committed port inventory; absent after 90 seconds without refresh. Use maximum across control replicas.

instruments.name: tnl_control_tls_certificate_expiration_timestamp_seconds
instruments.semantics: Locally loaded internal control certificate expiry. Public control TLS belongs to the deployment proxy.

instruments.name: tnl_control_webhook_provider_source_requests_total
instruments.semantics: Webhook sender-policy lookups by fixed provider and bounded outcome; not configured endpoints or webhook deliveries.

instruments.name: tnl_database_client_connection_events_total
instruments.semantics: Local database client connection lifecycle events.

instruments.name: tnl_database_client_connections
instruments.semantics: Current local database client sockets by purpose and state.

instruments.name: tnl_database_failures_total
instruments.semantics: Request-pool failures by fixed boundary and outcome; acquire has no SQL operation name.

instruments.name: tnl_database_guard_held_duration_seconds
instruments.semantics: Driver-observed interval from successful guard query completion through transaction completion; not exact PostgreSQL lock time.

instruments.name: tnl_database_operation_oldest_age_seconds
instruments.semantics: Age of the oldest active request-pool operation by compiled operation name.

instruments.name: tnl_database_operations_active
instruments.semantics: Current active request-pool operations by compiled operation name.

instruments.name: tnl_database_operations_omitted
instruments.semantics: Current active request-pool operations omitted by the bounded tracker.

instruments.name: tnl_database_pool_acquire_duration_seconds
instruments.semantics: Time to acquire a request-pool connection, including waits and failed acquisitions.

instruments.name: tnl_database_pool_acquire_wait_seconds_total
instruments.semantics: Time spent waiting on successful acquisitions from an empty pool.

instruments.name: tnl_database_pool_acquired_connections
instruments.semantics: Connections currently in use.

instruments.name: tnl_database_pool_acquires_total
instruments.semantics: Successful connection acquisitions.

instruments.name: tnl_database_pool_canceled_acquires_total
instruments.semantics: Connection acquisitions canceled before completion.

instruments.name: tnl_database_pool_idle_connections
instruments.semantics: Connections available for acquisition.

instruments.name: tnl_database_pool_max_connections
instruments.semantics: Configured connection limit.

instruments.name: tnl_database_pool_total_connections
instruments.semantics: Total pool connections, including those being constructed.

instruments.name: tnl_database_pool_waited_acquires_total
instruments.semantics: Successful acquisitions that waited for an available connection.

instruments.name: tnl_database_query_duration_seconds
instruments.semantics: Completed request-pool SQL duration observed by the driver, excluding pool acquisition.

instruments.name: tnl_ingress_backend_streams
instruments.semantics: Tracked backend streams including streams being opened, challenges, and denied connections.

instruments.name: tnl_ingress_connections
instruments.semantics: Current ingress admission slots by fixed connection class.

instruments.name: tnl_ingress_draining_rejections_total
instruments.semantics: Connections rejected because ingress was draining.

instruments.name: tnl_ingress_forwarded_bytes_total
instruments.semantics: Bytes forwarded through ingress, recorded after a copy finishes.

instruments.name: tnl_ingress_inspection_failures_total
instruments.semantics: Ingress connections rejected before classification by fixed failure stage.

instruments.name: tnl_ingress_lease_expiration_timestamp_seconds
instruments.semantics: Local ingress lease expiration; zero before registration or after lease loss.

instruments.name: tnl_ingress_operation_duration_seconds
instruments.semantics: Completed ingress operation duration by fixed operation and outcome.

instruments.name: tnl_ingress_recovery_observation_attempts_total
instruments.semantics: Recovery reporting attempts by bounded outcome.

instruments.name: tnl_ingress_recovery_observations_pending
instruments.semantics: Recovery observations awaiting a successful or stale response.

instruments.name: tnl_ingress_relay_attempts_total
instruments.semantics: Ingress internal-forwarding attempts by connection slot and bounded outcome.

instruments.name: tnl_ingress_routing_acknowledged_revision
instruments.semantics: Last routing-table revision acknowledged by a successful ingress lease renewal.

instruments.name: tnl_ingress_routing_applied_revision
instruments.semantics: Last applied routing-table revision.

instruments.name: tnl_ingress_routing_caught_up
instruments.semantics: Whether the last successful event response confirmed catch-up, cleared on update failure or resnapshot; not a guarantee about pending updates.

instruments.name: tnl_ingress_routing_initialized
instruments.semantics: Whether a routing snapshot has been applied; independent of lease readiness.

instruments.name: tnl_ingress_routing_last_acknowledged_timestamp_seconds
instruments.semantics: Unix time of the last routing-table acknowledgment; zero before success.

instruments.name: tnl_ingress_routing_last_caught_up_timestamp_seconds
instruments.semantics: Unix time of the last event response confirming catch-up; zero before confirmation.

instruments.name: tnl_ingress_routing_last_successful_check_timestamp_seconds
instruments.semantics: Unix time of the last successfully applied snapshot or event response, including empty responses; zero before success.

instruments.name: tnl_ingress_routing_latest_observed_revision
instruments.semantics: Highest control revision observed in a successfully applied routing response; pending requests may hide newer revisions.

instruments.name: tnl_ingress_routing_resnapshots_total
instruments.semantics: Resnapshot-required responses received from routing event requests.

instruments.name: tnl_ingress_routing_update_failures_total
instruments.semantics: Routing fetch or apply failures, excluding resnapshot-required responses and controller shutdown cancellation.

instruments.name: tnl_ingress_traffic_admissions_total
instruments.semantics: Process-local traffic decisions by fixed stage and result; excludes identities and network addresses.

instruments.name: tnl_ingress_usage_retained_buckets
instruments.semantics: Ingress usage buckets retained in memory, including dirty and pending buckets.

instruments.name: tnl_ingress_visitor_connections_total
instruments.semantics: Classified visitor connections by forwarding outcome; forwarded does not imply visitor TLS success.

instruments.name: tnl_ingress_visitor_stream_open_duration_seconds
instruments.semantics: Time from a classified visitor to a forwarding decision, excluding TLS and copy time.

instruments.name: tnl_observability_export_failures_total
instruments.semantics: Failed export batches after bounded retries; never gates readiness.

instruments.name: tnl_observability_export_lost_spans_total
instruments.semantics: Spans lost in failed export batches; excludes queue overflow.

instruments.name: tnl_observability_queue_dropped_spans_total
instruments.semantics: Sampled spans dropped by the bounded nonblocking export queue.

instruments.name: tnl_process_info
instruments.semantics: Process role (one for this process).

instruments.name: tnl_publisher_authorization_decisions_total
instruments.semantics: Authorization checks distinguish denial, allowed pending admission, admission and infrastructure failure.

instruments.name: tnl_publisher_configuration_current
instruments.semantics: Whether the latest control response matched the current run and approved configuration; target health is separate.

instruments.name: tnl_publisher_connection_attempts_total
instruments.semantics: Completed publisher connection races by selected transport and preference.

instruments.name: tnl_publisher_connection_events_total
instruments.semantics: Authenticated publisher connection establishment and expected or unexpected close events.

instruments.name: tnl_publisher_connections_active
instruments.semantics: Authenticated publisher connections held by this process; sum slots for local redundancy, not control readiness.

instruments.name: tnl_publisher_forwarded_bytes_total
instruments.semantics: HTTP body bytes read for target forwarding or written from accepted target responses, and opaque application copies, observed incrementally; excludes tnl-authored responses, HTTP headers, native authentication and TLS framing.

instruments.name: tnl_publisher_http_request_duration_seconds
instruments.semantics: HTTP handler lifetime including streaming and upgrades; no request paths or query parsing.

instruments.name: tnl_publisher_http_requests_active
instruments.semantics: HTTP handlers currently executing, including streaming and upgrades.

instruments.name: tnl_publisher_http_response_headers_duration_seconds
instruments.semantics: Time until final response headers, excluding informational responses.

instruments.name: tnl_publisher_lease_expiration_timestamp_seconds
instruments.semantics: Last confirmed control lease; failed refresh never extends it.

instruments.name: tnl_publisher_operation_duration_seconds
instruments.semantics: Finite publisher operations by authenticated identity and bounded outcome.

instruments.name: tnl_publisher_readiness_check_timestamp_seconds
instruments.semantics: Most recent readiness decision; timestamp requires freshness checks.

instruments.name: tnl_publisher_readiness_last_check_timestamp_seconds
instruments.semantics: Most recent publisher readiness check, including unsuccessful checks.

instruments.name: tnl_publisher_readiness_last_success_timestamp_seconds
instruments.semantics: Most recent successful publisher readiness check; a failure never advances it.

instruments.name: tnl_publisher_ready
instruments.semantics: Current publisher readiness decision; combine with last check and confirmed lease expiration for freshness.

instruments.name: tnl_publisher_recovery_duration_seconds
instruments.semantics: Publisher-local time from unexpected connection loss until an observed target response (HTTP headers or stream bytes); includes waiting for traffic, not visitor delivery or outage duration.

instruments.name: tnl_publisher_target_healthy
instruments.semantics: Latest target health decision; independent of publisher lease and configuration validity.

instruments.name: tnl_publisher_tls_handshakes_total
instruments.semantics: Completed TLS handshakes; negotiated version and resumption only on success.

instruments.name: tnl_publisher_transport_candidate_duration_seconds
instruments.semantics: Publisher transport candidate connection and authentication duration; count includes both raced candidates, not only the winner.

instruments.name: tnl_publisher_visitor_stream_completions_total
instruments.semantics: Application stream copies completed by outcome.

instruments.name: tnl_publisher_visitor_streams_active
instruments.semantics: Publisher application streams currently forwarding.

instruments.name: tnl_relay_earliest_lease_expiration_timestamp_seconds
instruments.semantics: Earliest known relay lease expiration in this process; zero without a lease.

instruments.name: tnl_relay_forwarded_bytes_total
instruments.semantics: Wire bytes copied by relay, including preserved PROXY metadata; recorded at stream close.

instruments.name: tnl_relay_local_leases
instruments.semantics: Relay leases held by this process by state; not a control-wide lease count.

instruments.name: tnl_relay_operation_duration_seconds
instruments.semantics: Completed relay operation duration by fixed operation and outcome.

instruments.name: tnl_relay_publisher_connection_exits_total
instruments.semantics: Ready publisher connections that ended, by expectedness.

instruments.name: tnl_relay_publisher_connections_ready
instruments.semantics: Publisher connections marked ready on relays in this process.

instruments.name: tnl_relay_publisher_connections_registered
instruments.semantics: Locally registered publisher connections, including those not yet ready; not authoritative database claims.

instruments.name: tnl_relay_stun_bindings_total
instruments.semantics: Relay STUN Binding decisions by fixed result; excludes network addresses.

instruments.name: tnl_relay_transport_certificate_expiration_timestamp_seconds
instruments.semantics: Earliest locally known relay transport certificate expiry; zero before material is observed.

instruments.name: tnl_relay_visitor_stream_completions_total
instruments.semantics: Opened visitor streams whose relay copy ended, not application request outcomes.

instruments.name: tnl_relay_visitor_stream_rejections_total
instruments.semantics: Relay stream rejections other than capacity exhaustion, by fixed reason.

instruments.name: tnl_relay_visitor_stream_slots_occupied
instruments.semantics: Occupied relay forwarding-stream slots, including opens in progress.

instruments.name: tnl_service_audit_events_total
instruments.semantics: Process-local service audit queue and ingestion counts by fixed result; queued observations can be lost on a crash.

instruments.name: tnl_target_discovery_cache_lookups_total
instruments.semantics: Publisher cache decisions by fixed type, protocol and health; last_success is bounded transient fallback, never a new success.

instruments.name: tnl_target_discovery_duration_seconds
instruments.semantics: Publisher AWS metadata refresh duration by fixed provider, target type, protocol and result; excludes cache hits.

instruments.name: tnl_target_discovery_last_success_timestamp_seconds
instruments.semantics: Last success of the target observed by the most recent lookup in this fixed type/protocol class; not a per-resource freshness guarantee.
